# HireNest - AI-Powered Recruitment Platform

HireNest is an AI-powered platform connecting job seekers with employers through intelligent matching, resume building, and comprehensive hiring tools. We help businesses achieve faster hiring cycles and job seekers find their perfect roles.

## Website
https://hirenest.ai

## Description

HireNest is an AI-driven recruitment platform that bridges the gap between talent and opportunity. Key features include:

- AI-powered resume building and optimization
- Intelligent job matching algorithms based on skills and experience
- Automated candidate ranking and screening
- Comprehensive skill assessments and verification
- Real-time hiring analytics and insights
- Team collaboration tools for streamlined decision-making
- Interview preparation resources for 1715 job titles
- Resume keyword optimization for ATS systems with 16000+ keywords
- Comprehensive job descriptions for 1715 job titles
- Salary guides and compensation data for 1715 job titles
- Professional cover letter examples and templates for 1715 job titles

## Target Audience

- Job Seekers looking for career advancement
- Employers and Hiring Managers seeking top talent
- Recruitment Agencies managing multiple clients
- HR Departments optimizing their hiring processes
- Educational Institutions looking to place graduates

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 15
- React 19
- TypeScript
- Chakra UI
- AI/ML Integration
